<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" xmlns:ex="urn:example:ignored" version="1.0" datamodel="xpath" initial="idle" name="orders">
  <datamodel>
    <data id="order"><order xmlns="" id="o-1"><item sku="A" qty="2"/><item sku="B" qty="1"/><total>30</total></order></data>
    <data id="retries" expr="0"/>
    <data id="maxRetries" expr="3"/>
    <data id="lastError" expr="''"/>
    <data id="log"/>
  </datamodel>
  <state id="idle">
    <transition event="order.submit" target="validating">
      <assign location="$order" expr="$_event/data/order"/>
    </transition>
  </state>
  <state id="validating">
    <onentry>
      <if cond="count($order/order/item) = 0">
        <raise event="order.invalid"/>
      <elseif cond="number($order/order/total) <= 0"/>
        <raise event="order.invalid"/>
      <else/>
        <raise event="order.valid"/>
      </if>
    </onentry>
    <transition event="order.valid" target="processing"/>
    <transition event="order.invalid" target="rejected"/>
  </state>
  <state id="processing" initial="charging">
    <onexit><log label="processing" expr="concat('leaving with retries=', $retries)"/></onexit>
    <state id="charging">
      <onentry>
        <send event="payment.request" target="#_internal">
          <param name="amount" expr="$order/order/total"/>
        </send>
        <send id="payTimeout" event="payment.timeout" delay="5s"/>
      </onentry>
      <onexit><cancel sendid="payTimeout"/></onexit>
      <transition event="payment.ok" target="shipping"/>
      <transition event="payment.failed payment.timeout" cond="$retries < $maxRetries" target="charging">
        <assign location="$retries" expr="$retries + 1"/>
        <assign location="$lastError" expr="string($_event/name)"/>
      </transition>
      <transition event="payment.failed payment.timeout" target="failed" cond="false()"/>
      <transition event="payment.*" target="failed"/>
    </state>
    <state id="shipping">
      <onentry>
        <foreach array="$order/order/item" item="it" index="idx">
          <log label="ship" expr="concat($it/@sku, ' x', $it/@qty)"/>
        </foreach>
      </onentry>
      <transition event="shipment.done" target="done"/>
    </state>
    <history id="hist" type="deep"><transition target="charging"/></history>
    <transition event="pause" target="paused"/>
  </state>
  <state id="paused">
    <transition event="resume" target="hist"/>
    <transition event="cancel" cond="In('paused')" target="rejected"/>
  </state>
  <state id="failed"><transition event="retry" target="processing"/></state>
  <final id="rejected"/>
  <final id="done">
    <donedata><param name="orderId" expr="string($order/order/@id)"/></donedata>
  </final>
</scxml>
